content.short: 3,333 hand-drawn soul NFTs, brought to you by the SOUL Token team and built on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
Haunted Souls Club is a collection of 3,333 hand drawn soul NFTs, brought to you by the SOUL Token team and built on the Cardano blockchain.

Every soul is unique, so there are no other souls exactly like it. There are 76 total possible traits, and some traits are rarer than others! Some souls are silly, some are scary, and some are just downright cute!

The collection will launch and minting will begin on February 1st 2022. Holders of our $SOUL Token will be able to mint one Haunted Soul NFT for free for every 200,000 $SOUL they hold on our launch date.
